Introduction. Turnip seeds can be planted using the Cultivator in order to grow 1x Turnip.

Availability. • Turnip seeds can be found in the Swamp by harvesting their flowers. Picked seeds won't respawn.
• Due to Swamps being mostly covered in water, turnip seeds are considerably harder to find than carrot seeds. The water causes turnip seeds to generate less frequently.
• Three turnip seeds can be obtained by planting a Turnip using the Cultivator option "Seed-turnip".

Notes. • It takes between 4000s and 5000s (between 66m40s and 83m20s, or about 2.22-2.78 in-game days) for them to fully grow.
